title: Deployment
subtitle: Push approved prices to sales channels

jobs.title: Publish jobs
jobs.empty: No publish jobs yet. Deploying an approved recommendation creates one.

publish.title: Publish price change
publish.recovery: Scheduled jobs can be cancelled before they run; published jobs can be rolled back to the previous price.

check.approval: Recommendation is approved and not yet deployed
check.duplicate: No active publish job for this recommendation

publish.untilHint: After this time the publish window closes and the price reverts — recorded as a publish_window_end audit event.

rollback.title: Roll back publish job
rollback.recovery: Recorded in the audit trail. The recommendation returns to the deploy queue for a fresh publish job.
rollback.done: {sku} rolled back to the previous price

queue.title: Awaiting deployment
queue.empty: Nothing waiting. Approved recommendations appear here.

recovery.retry: Retry re-runs this channel only — other channels are unaffected. Each retry is recorded in the audit trail.

err.forbidden: Only an Ops Lead can deploy.
err.locked: This row is already in progress.
err.not_rollbackable: Only published or partially-published jobs can be rolled back.
err.restore_bounds: Cannot restore the previous price — it is outside the product's current bounds.
